summary: All 3 new features PASS end-to-end. BACKEND (10/10 pytest): (1) Admin Settings — GET /api/admin/settings without token -> 401; with Bearer -> 200 returning {deepgram_stt_model:'nova-2', deepgram_api_key_set:false, deepgram_api_key_masked:''} (raw key never exposed). POST /api/admin/settings {key:'deepgram_stt_model',value:'nova-2'} -> 200 {ok:true, key:'deepgram_stt_model'}; GET after write confirms persistence. POST with unsupported key 'not_allowed' -> 400 as expected. POST without token -> 401. (2) TTS explicit voice+speed — POST /api/tts {text:'Hola, encantado de conocerte', target_lang:'es', voice:'shimmer', speed:1.25} -> 200 with non-empty audio_base64 (>1KB, mime audio/mpeg). POST /api/tts with voice omitted -> 200 (server defaults from lang_voice). (3) Whisper fallback — with no Deepgram key set, POST /api/tts (en) then feeding audio_base64 into POST /api/transcribe {mime_type:'audio/mpeg',language:'en'} -> 200 with non-empty transcribed text; sent via requests (curl fallback wired in case of CF 1010, not needed on this run). FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844, no redbox): /voice-screen mounts with mascot + 'Tap Chingu to start the live chat'. voice-open-voice-settings taps open the picker card; all 6 voice options (nova/shimmer/alloy/echo/onyx/coral) and all 4 speed options (0.75/1/1.25/1.5) render as testIDs. Selecting Shimmer + 1.25x then Done closes the sheet cleanly; reopening shows Shimmer and 1.25x chips highlighted — persistence via prefs store confirmed. /admin-login accepts chingunadi/0644782611 and lands on /admin; admin-tab-settings opens admin-settings-panel with settings-deepgram-key, settings-deepgram-model, settings-save; typing 'nova-3' and tapping Save shows settings-msg 'Saved ✓'. Model was reset to 'nova-2' at test end to keep environment clean.

issues: The 5 admin tabs (Stats/Conversations/Translations/Builds/Settings) overflow horizontally on a 390px viewport — the Settings tab is partially off-screen until the row is scrolled. Not blocking (still tappable and horizontally scrollable), but consider wrapping/flexWrap or shortening chip padding on narrow screens. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin.tsx:162-168

react_native_issues.issue: voice-screen.tsx still imports 'expo-file-system/legacy'. Works on SDK 54 but the legacy subpath is scheduled for removal — plan a migration to the current expo-file-system File/Directory API. Reference: /app/frontend/app/voice-screen.tsx:18

action_items: No blockers. Optional: on narrow (<=390px) viewports the admin tabs row clips the last tab; consider flexWrap or a horizontal ScrollView for the tabs bar.
Optional: migrate voice-screen.tsx off 'expo-file-system/legacy' before the subpath is removed in a future Expo SDK.

Console noise on web preview (non-blocking, unchanged from iter 17): 'shadow* style props deprecated → use boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated → use style.pointerEvents', 'Font.loadAsync patch failed'. Consider silencing the Font.loadAsync monkey-patch on web where it is a no-op.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: /api/admin/settings never returns the raw Deepgram key — only a boolean 'set' flag and a masked tail. ADMIN_SETTABLE_KEYS is a strict allowlist and unsupported keys return 400.

Good: /api/transcribe reads the Deepgram key from db.settings each call and correctly falls back to OpenAI Whisper when unset — Whisper roundtrip decoded synthesized English audio to real text, so the fallback path is genuinely wired (not stubbed).
Good: TTS accepts optional voice+speed; when voice omitted, lang_voice(target_lang) picks per-language default and defaults to 'nova' — matches the frontend prefs contract.
Frontend voice picker correctly persists selection per target_lang via the prefs store (verified by reopening the sheet and seeing Shimmer + 1.25x still highlighted).
Admin settings save flow correctly posts SettingIn{key,value} with the admin Bearer token; the 'Saved ✓' message is driven off the 200/ok response — verified live.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (voice picker + admin settings tab both work end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: None — used the existing seeded admin (chingunadi). Test set deepgram_stt_model to 'nova-3' briefly then reset to 'nova-2'. Deepgram API key remains unset (as required for Whisper-fallback validation).
